summary: No actionable defects found. The change is additive around bounded token lifetime and rotation, and the task acceptance was already met at the base commit through finite clamping, legacy sentinel rejection, last-use display, and regression coverage.

evidence: Base src/auth_store.ts:448-451 treats the year-9999 sentinel as expired, and createAgentToken at 1989-2023 clamps every requested TTL to the finite 365-day maximum with matching KV expirations.
Base src/auth_config.ts:327-343 maps omitted, zero, negative, invalid, and oversized ttlDays values to finite bounded lifetimes before token creation.
Base src/passport.ts:1919-1921 returns lastUsedAt and public/agent_tokens.js:285-287 displays it; docs/agent-login.md:129-132 requires a new consent ceremony on expiration.

Base tests/bun_test.ts:992-1090 covers omitted, zero, negative, NaN, Infinity, oversized, expired, and year-9999 credentials and verifies they cannot remain usable; handler and config tests cover device and request parsing paths.
